value.rationale: The source identifies a natural phase transition in mean first-passage time with a marginal alpha=1/2 infinite-mean boundary for pure-power jump-rate tails. Resolving whether the identical power index may instead have finite mean after logarithmic strengthening is a sharply motivated boundary question, not a parameter relabeling. A necessary-and-sufficient condition for every iid rate law, invariance of its finiteness verdict under fixed redraw period and starting distance, and realizable kappa>1 versus kappa<=1 regimes give an actionable classification of a central first-passage observable.
